instruction: I need to change the font for all text in my Impress presentation to 'Calibri'. Can you help me do this without selecting each text box individually?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all fonts in a 28-slide presentation from Arial to Calibri. Evaluator extracts all unique fonts used and verifies only 'Calibri' is present. Original presentation uses Arial font throughout.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts all unique fonts from presentation by iterating through slides, shapes, text_frame, paragraphs, and runs
Metric properly verifies that result equals exactly {'Calibri'}, ensuring all text uses only the target font
Complete coverage: instruction requires changing all text to Calibri, evaluator checks exactly this requirement
Postconfig appropriately saves file (Ctrl+S) before verification to ensure getter reads persisted state
Expected value 'Calibri' correctly matches the instruction requirement
Edge cases handled: getter checks hasattr(shape, 'text_frame') and 'if run.font.name' to handle shapes without text and None values
Data flow is correct: getter extracts set of fonts → metric compares with expected single-font set → returns 1.0 for exact match
